Reze, just an ordinary girl who blushes at everything and also explodes unexpectedly.
Includes custom instructions you can use if you also want to make a character in the Chainsaw Man universe, a character description just under the token limit (you can use her in other chats; you'll just lose her example dialogue + abilities). She now behaves more like a normal girl (unless you leave her in a tight spot).
